correctness.rationale: Every two-spoke edge pair has resolving neighborhood exactly its two outer endpoints, giving all pair inequalities; every other edge-pair resolving neighborhood contains at least two outer vertices, so those inequalities suffice and the center is free. Coordinatewise minimality forces center weight zero, the two smallest outer weights to sum to one, and every other positive coordinate to be tight with the smallest, yielding exactly the claimed family. The assigned distance/LP verifier corroborates cases \(2\le k\le8\).
